# Nuno Loureiro

> Lead Product Designer at Ethereum Foundation, based in Lisbon, Portugal. 25+ years of experience in product design, UX, visual design, and creative direction. Currently focused on improving the user experience of ethereum.org and building design tools for the Ethereum ecosystem.

Nuno Loureiro is a designer who has led teams and shipped products across web, mobile, and branding at the Ethereum Foundation, Trojan Horse was a Unicorn, Bright Pixel, and Sapo. He studied Industrial Design at IADE — Creative University in Lisbon and taught himself HTML/CSS in 2003. His work spans product design, design systems, front-end implementation, and open source design within the Ethereum ecosystem.

For professional inquiries, speaking engagements, or collaboration: mail@nloureiro.com

## About

- [About Nuno](https://nloureiro.com/about): Full background — from industrial design in Lisbon to leading design at Ethereum Foundation

## Work & Portfolio

- [Portfolio overview](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio): Complete list of selected projects
- [Ethereum Foundation](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/ethereum): UX and visual design for ethereum.org and Ethereum ecosystem tools (2023–present)
- [Trojan Horse was a Unicorn](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/thu): Digital transformation and platform design for a global creative community (2020–2022)
- [Público Mobile Applications](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/publico): Mobile app design for one of Portugal's major newspapers (2019)
- [Bright Pixel System](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/brpx): Brand communication system and creative direction (2016–2019)
- [Portugal Participatory Budget](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/opp): Civic participation platform accessible to all Portuguese citizens (2018)
- [MEO Cloud](https://nloureiro.com/portfolio/meocloud): Cloud storage product design for all screens (2014–2016)
